results.title: E-file provider services | Internal Revenue Service
results.snippet: EROs must e-file five or more returns in a tax season to be eligible. Circular 230 practitioners need only apply and be approved. ... You must have an e-Services username and password and a completed e-file application before participating.

results.title: Become an authorized e-file provider | Internal Revenue Service
results.snippet: In order to access the e-file application, you must sign in with an existing account or create a new account. Once you are able to sign in, you will be able to complete and submit an e-file application.

results.title: Tax Pros: Become an authorized e-file provider in three steps | Internal Revenue Service
results.snippet: The process is as easy as 1-2-3. E-filing is the most secure and accurate way to file returns, and it saves time. Tax pros can complete and submit an authorized e-file provider application online with IRS.gov.

results.title: IRS e-file Application & Participation
results.snippet: An Authorized IRS e-file Provider (Provider) is a business or organization authorized by the IRS to participate · in IRS e-file. It may be a sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation or other entity. The firm submits an e-file · application, meets the eligibility criteria and must pass a suitability check before the IRS assigns an Electronic · Filing Identification Number (EFIN). Applicants accepted for participation in IRS e-file become Authorized IRS e-file

results.title: Tax pros: Apply to be an IRS authorized e-file provider in a few simple steps | Internal Revenue Service
results.snippet: Check for prior non-compliance with IRS e-file requirements. It can take up to 45 days from the date of submission for the IRS to approve an application.
